chaetocladus.chosen_subject: Chaetocladus plumula single plume-bearing fossil axis, Whitfield1894 PlateXI11-13
chaetocladus.age: Ordovician Trenton Group, Platteville Wisconsin, NOT Silurian
chaetocladus.basis: Specific original plate personally inspected. Fig11 little horizontal plume belongs to another shale layer; do not attach it as a branch. Fig12 close whorls of hairlike laterals with occasional fork; Fig13 isolated apparent constricted bifurcation. No rhizoid, holdfast or whole organism certainty. Modern C.gracilis and C.capitatus not substituted for this plate.
chaetocladus.limitations: Original drawing, not a photograph or exact cast; interpretive flattened solid volume and nominal counts. Taxon-specific details await independent factual review.

protosalvinia.subject: One bilobed oval/reniform fossil-organ compression, not whole plant or microscopic spores
protosalvinia.primary_pixels: Dawson1888 Fig16B only, not A C D E; historic drawing. MuseumFig6c photograph supplemental lacks crisp bilobed contour. Modern USGS1970 plate pixels unavailable, text read.
protosalvinia.uncertainty: Dawson historical water-fern/sporocarp interpretation is not adopted. Affinity unresolved; no interior/spores invented.
